title: Figma Generator Test Refactoring - Structural + Snapshot Pattern
overview: Refactor remaining Figma generator tests from brittle exact-value assertions to flexible structural + snapshot pattern. This enables design iteration while maintaining regression protection.

context.problem: Current tests are too tightly coupled to design implementation details (exact Tailwind classes, pixel values, color strings). This makes them brittle - they fail when design changes even though the functional contract (AST → Parser → Figma data structure) remains valid.
context.current_state: 13/29 generators (45%) have been refactored to use structural + snapshot pattern. Tier 1 generators (Badge, Banner, Button, Checkbox, ClipboardText, Code, Text, Input, Select, Dialog, Tabs, Toast) are complete.
context.why_now: Continuing Phase 6 (Test Coverage) from PLAN.md. Need to complete remaining Tier 2-4 generators before starting Phase 3 (Parser Improvements) and Phase 7 (Documentation).

primary: Refactor remaining 16 generator tests to use structural + snapshot pattern
Ensure tests verify functional contract, not design details
Document test patterns for future contributors
metrics: 0 exact-value assertions for Tailwind classes (brittle pattern eliminated)
All tests follow structural + snapshot template
Test execution time remains under 5s for full suite

functional.title: Structural Validation
functional.description: Tests must verify that required properties exist and have correct types, not exact values
acceptance: No exact string matches for Tailwind classes

functional.title: Snapshot Regression Protection
functional.description: Tests must use snapshots to catch unintended changes in parsed output
acceptance: Snapshot test for complete variant data
Snapshots captured for each variant individually

functional.title: Registry Validation
functional.description: Tests must verify component-registry.json structure matches expectations
acceptance: Verify expected variants exist in registry
Verify classes defined for all variants
Verify descriptions defined for all variants

functional.title: Testable Exports
functional.description: All generators must export pure functions for testing (no Figma API calls)
acceptance: Functions return plain objects, no Figma API calls

non_functional.title: Test Performance
non_functional.description: Full test suite must run in under 5 seconds

non_functional.title: Pattern Consistency
non_functional.description: All tests follow the same 3-section structure
sections: 1. Registry Validation - Verify source of truth
2. Structural Validation - Verify parsed output structure

non_functional.title: Maintainability
non_functional.description: Tests should be easy to update when design changes
acceptance: No hardcoded expected values in assertions
Snapshots can be updated with single command

in_scope: Refactor Tier 2 generators: dropdown, combobox (2 generators)
Refactor Tier 3 generators: tooltip, collapsible, date-range-picker, loader, meter, pagination (6 generators)
Refactor Tier 4 generators: switch, link-button, refresh-button, input-area, sensitive-input, surface, layer-card, menubar (8 generators)
Add testable exports to all generators (getVariantConfig, getParsedStyles, getAllVariantData)
out_of_scope: Adding new generators for missing components (Breadcrumbs, Empty, Field, PageHeader)
Parser enhancements (Phase 3 - arbitrary values, opacity modifiers)

tests: should have all expected variants in registry
should have classes defined for all variants
should have descriptions defined for all variants

structural_validation.purpose: Verify parsed output has required properties with correct types
tests: should parse base styles correctly (if baseStyles exist)
should parse variant styles correctly (for each variant)
should parse styling metadata correctly (if styling exists)

snapshot_tests.purpose: Catch unintended changes via snapshot comparison
tests: should produce consistent parsed base styles
should produce consistent parsed variant styles (for each variant)
should produce consistent complete variant data (golden path)

implementation_order: 2. Tier 3 (Lower Usage): tooltip, collapsible, date-range-picker, loader, meter, pagination
3. Tier 4 (Specialized): switch, link-button, refresh-button, input-area, sensitive-input, surface, layer-card, menubar

constraints: Must not change generator implementation (only tests)
Must maintain existing test coverage (no reduction)

All tests must pass before moving to next tier

risks.risk: Some generators may not have sufficient metadata in registry
risks.mitigation: Phase 4 already added styling exports to key components. If needed, add KUMO_*_STYLING exports during refactoring.

risks.risk: Complex generators (Dialog, Toast) may have too many test permutations
risks.mitigation: Follow existing pattern: test key examples + snapshot full data structure

risks.risk: Snapshot files may become large and hard to review
risks.mitigation: Break into multiple snapshot tests per variant. Use descriptive snapshot names.
